'''June 2000 Las Vegas tournament (14 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local (unsanctioned sealed deck) held in Hines Ranch, Las Vegas on 14 June 2000. It is known from Danny Rider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d892">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-14-6-14-00-vegas-sealed-deckd892/ 6-14-00-vegas-sealed-deck], DeckTech (Danny "Skuff D" Rider, 14 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-14-6-14-00-vegas-sealed-deckd892/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Hines Ranch, Las Vegas
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
